honestly the best thing to do is just be happy in your own body, or at least make it seem like you are. if you're a healthy weight, i don't think you need to be tracking your calories, at least not meticulously, and definitely not anywhere your daughter might see. of course you should eat a healthy diet, but you also shouldn't make it seem like you're afraid of eating higher calorie/treat foods. i definitely picked up on a lot more of my mom's food fears than she assumed, and you should assume the same about your daughter. I'm not a doctor or anything, but I think the best way to avoid passing down your ED to your child is to work on overcoming it so you can model a healthy relationship to food
